_comment: Labeled evaluation set for the eligibility agent.
Cases supply a structured patient profile rather than a raw note, so the
numbers measure the agent's reasoning and not the NLP extractor's coverage.
Those are different failure modes and blending them makes both unreadable:
an agent that correctly says UNKNOWN because the extractor dropped a field
is behaving properly, and should not be scored as if it had guessed.
Every expected verdict is derived from what the profile actually contains,
not from what the prose implies. Where a criterion cannot be settled from
the profile, the expected verdict is UNKNOWN -- those cases carry the most
weight, because refusing to guess is the property the design claims.

cases.description: Every criterion decidable and satisfied. Baseline that the agent can reach a positive verdict at all.
